gloss: carrot and stick; reward and punishment

definitions.gloss: carrot and stick; reward and punishment; the soft and hard approach
definitions.explanation: A strategy of using both incentives (rewards) and deterrents (punishment) to achieve a desired outcome. Literally 'candy and whip.' Equivalent to the English expression 'carrot and stick.'

examples.japanese: {飴|あめ}と{鞭|むち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧。
examples.english: To use the carrot and the stick appropriately.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飴|あめ}と{鞭|むち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧。
examples.english: That boss is good at using the carrot and stick approach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飴|あめ}と{鞭|むち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: They say the balance between reward and punishment is important in child-rearing.

notes: Literally 'candy and whip.' The expression is thought to derive from Bismarck's domestic policy approach (Zuckerbrot und Peitsche, 'sugar bread and whip'). Common collocations: {飴|あめ}と{鞭|むち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧ (to skillfully alternate between reward and punishment), {飴|あめ}と{鞭|むち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (carrot-and-stick policy). Used in contexts of management, parenting, education, and politics.
